entities.name: Dnipro Art Museum
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Dnipro Art Museum is a museum of fine arts in the city of Dnipro, Ukraine. It is among the oldest museums in Ukraine. About 8,500 paintings, drawings, sculptures, and decorative arts pieces from the 16th to the 21st centuries are part of the museum's collection.
